result:
The behaviour of `UserService.getUserByUuid` is consumed by the core REST module's generic `/ws/rest/v1` resources, which live in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`, not in `openmrs-core`. I did not find any REST resource code in `openmrs-core`.

**The changed declaration:** `UserService.getUserByUuid` at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/UserService.java:109`, implemented in `UserServiceImpl.java:662`. I ignored the same-named DAO declarations (`UserDAO`, `ContextDAO` and their Hibernate implementations), since those are different declarations.

**Confirmed production callers in the REST module:**
- `UserResource1_8.getByUniqueId` (lines 207–211) backs `/ws/rest/v1/user/{uuid}` lookups, and returns null when the user is missing.
- `UserConverter1_8.getByUniqueId` (lines 34–37) converts a UUID string to a `User` for any resource that has a `User`-typed property.
- `AlertRecipientResource2_0.setRecipientProperty` (lines 84–93) resolves the recipient UUID when creating or updating alert recipients. It silently keeps the old recipient when the lookup returns null.
- `ProviderSearchHandler1_9.search` (lines 52–64) finds providers for the `?user=` search. It returns an empty result when the lookup returns null.
- `ChangePasswordController1_8.changeOthersPassword` (lines 67–85) looks up the target user for `POST /password/{userUuid}`. A null result becomes a 404.

**Likely but unverified:**
- `ConversionUtil.java` (`omod-common/.../ConversionUtil.java`, lines 242–246) dispatches string-to-`User` conversions to `UserConverter1_8`. This is how the converter reaches every resource that has a `User` property, but I only read the dispatch code, not every resource that relies on it.

**Tests that would fail if the behaviour changed** (usage lines only, not full method bounds): `UserResource2_0Test`, `UserResource1_9Test`, `AlertResource2_0Test`, `AlertRecipientResource2_0Test`, `AlertController2_0Test`, `AlertRecipientController2_0Test`, `UserController1_8Test`, `UserController2_0Test`, `ChangePasswordController1_8Test`, `PasswordResetController2_2Test`.

**Not checked:** the generic `DelegatingCrudResource` base classes that call `getByUniqueId`, any other repositories beyond the grep over `*.java` (the grep was capped at 200 matches, so the REST module was searched separately), and reflection or dynamic dispatch through the converter registry.
